title: Ranking Function Generation with LLMs for Termination
title_zh: 面向终止性证明的基于LLM的排序函数生成

paragraphs.en: Ranking functions are a fundamental technique for proving loop termination, but constructing them manually is challenging and requires substantial expertise. Existing automated approaches are limited when handling, for instance, nonlinear updates and complex control flows in real-world programs. Meanwhile, large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of software engineering tasks. Motivated by these advances, we explore LLM-based ranking function generation for proving loop termination, a key component of establishing total program correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 排序函数是证明循环终止的基本技术，但手动构造它们具有挑战性，并且需要大量专业知识。 现有的自动化方法在处理实际程序中的非线性更新和复杂控制流等问题时存在局限。 与此同时，大语言模型（LLMs）最近在广泛的软件工程任务中展现出了卓越的能力。 受这些进展的启发，我们探索基于大语言模型的排序函数生成，用于证明循环终止，而循环终止是建立程序完全正确性的关键组成部分。

sents.en: Motivated by these advances, we explore LLM-based ranking function generation for proving loop termination, a key component of establishing total program correctness.
sents.zh: 受这些进展的启发，我们探索基于大语言模型的排序函数生成，用于证明循环终止，而循环终止是建立程序完全正确性的关键组成部分。

paragraphs.en: We propose RAINFALL , a neuro-symbolic framework which follows the generate-verify-refine paradigm and tightly integrates LLMs with symbolic verification. RAINFALL formulates ranking function synthesis as a code-completion task by inserting placeholders into the input program and constraining the LLM to fill four predefined slots for each loop. The completed program is then checked by a symbolic verifier. If verification succeeds, a valid ranking function is obtained; otherwise, the verifier’s diagnostics are translated into natural-language feedback that guides iterative refinement of the LLM’s output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RAINFALL，一个遵循“生成-验证-精炼”范式、将大语言模型与符号验证紧密集成的神经符号框架。 RAINFALL 通过在输入程序中插入占位符，并将大语言模型约束为为每个循环填充四个预定义槽位，把排序函数综合建模为代码补全任务。 补全后的程序随后由符号验证器进行检查。 如果验证成功，则获得一个有效的排序函数；否则，验证器的诊断信息会被转化为自然语言反馈，指导对大语言模型输出的迭代精炼。

sents.en: RAINFALL formulates ranking function synthesis as a code-completion task by inserting placeholders into the input program and constraining the LLM to fill four predefined slots for each loop.

sents.en: If verification succeeds, a valid ranking function is obtained; otherwise, the verifier’s diagnostics are translated into natural-language feedback that guides iterative refinement of the LLM’s output.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RAINFALL on two public benchmark suites comprising 358 terminating C programs. Using MiniMax V2.7, RAINFALL synthesizes verifiable ranking functions for 323 programs (90.22%), outperforming all promising baselines. In particular, it solves 12 more programs than PROTON 2.1, the best-performing baseline and winner of the SV-COMP 2026 Termination category. Furthermore, combining RAINFALL with PROTON 2.1 increases the success rate to 96.65% (346/358 programs). We also conduct ablation study confirming individual contributions of placeholder contracts, few-shot examples, symbolic verification, and diagnostic information feedback. Experiments across LLMs further confirm the effectiveness of RAINFALL .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在包含 358 个可终止 C 程序的两个公开基准测试套件上评估 RAINFALL。 使用 MiniMax V2.7，RAINFALL 为 323 个程序（90.22%）合成了可验证的排序函数，超越了所有有前景的基线方法。 特别地，它比表现最佳的基线方法、SV-COMP 2026 终止性类别冠军 PROTON 2.1 多解决了 12 个程序。 此外，将 RAINFALL 与 PROTON 2.1 相结合可将成功率提升至 96.65%（346/358 个程序）。 我们还进行了消融实验，证实了占位符契约、少样本示例、符号验证和诊断信息反馈各自的贡献。 跨大语言模型的实验进一步证实了 RAINFALL 的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest a generic, sound framework for ranking-function synthesis and, beyond termination, LLM-assisted synthesis of formally checkable liveness certificates, both of which represent new directions of software engineering research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，这是一个通用的、可靠的排序函数合成框架，并且——超越终止性之外——还展示了 LLM 辅助合成的、可形式化验证的活性证书，这两者都代表了软件工程研究的新方向。

paragraphs.en: Program termination is a fundamental liveness property for ensuring software reliability and total correctness ( Floyd, 1967 ) , and plays an important role in software verification ( D’Silva et al., 2008 ; Shi et al., 2022 ; Alon and David, 2022 ) . While program termination is undecidable in general ( Turing et al., 1936 ) , automated techniques have been developed over the years to prove termination for many classes of programs. A standard approach is to synthesize a ranking function that maps program states to a well-founded set such that the function value strictly decreases with each loop iteration and is bounded below by a constant. The existence of such a function (referred to as a valid ranking function) guarantees that the loop can execute only finitely many times when the bound entails the termination of the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 程序终止性是确保软件可靠性与完全正确性（Floyd, 1967）的基本活性属性，并在软件验证中扮演重要角色（D'Silva et al., 2008; Shi et al., 2022; Alon and David, 2022）。 尽管程序终止性在一般情况下是不可判定的（Turing et al., 1936），但多年来人们已经开发出多种自动化技术来证明许多类别程序的终止性。 一种标准做法是综合出一个排序函数，它将程序状态映射到一个良基集合，使得该函数值随着每次循环迭代严格递减，并且以一个常数为下界。 当该界蕴含循环终止时，这种函数（称为有效排序函数）的存在性保证循环只能执行有限多次。

paragraphs.en: Classical symbolic techniques for ranking function synthesis typically formulate the problem as constraint solving over predefined parameterized ranking templates, such as linear expressions, lexicographic orders, or multiphase combinations ( Ben-Amram and Genaim, 2017 ; Ben-Amram and Genaim, 2013 ; Bradley et al., 2005c ; Harris et al., 2010 ; Larraz et al., 2013 ; Leike and Heizmann, 2015 ; Podelski and Rybalchenko, 2004 ; Podelski and Rybalchenko, 2005 ) . Instantiating the ranking template with a satisfying assignment gives rise to a ranking function. While these approaches have been largely successful, their effectiveness heavily depends on the availability of suitable templates. In practice, designing new ranking templates for diverse loop programs remains challenging and continues to be an active area of research (cf., e.g. ( Leike and Heizmann, 2015 ) ). In general, classical approaches often require substantial manual effort or expensive template exploration, which limits their scalability and degree of automation.

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, recent work has explored leveraging machine learning, particularly (pre-trained) Large Language Models (LLMs), to generate ranking functions. This is motivated by the remarkable capabilities in assisting software development tasks ( Hou et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Han and Lyu, 2025 ; Sevenhuijsen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , including specification and loop invariant generation ( Cosler et al., 2023 ; Hahn et al., 2022 ; Kamath et al., 2023 ; Chakraborty et al., 2023 ; Endres et al., 2024 ; Lahiri, 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Granberry et al., 2024 ; Mugnier et al., 2024 ; Misu et al., 2024 ; Pirzada et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，近期的工作探索了利用机器学习，特别是（预训练的）大语言模型（LLMs），来生成排序函数。 这一思路的动机在于大语言模型在辅助软件开发任务方面的卓越能力（Hou et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2023；Han and Lyu, 2025；Sevenhuijsen et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2024），包括规约与循环不变式的生成（Cosler et al., 2023；Hahn et al., 2022；Kamath et al., 2023；Chakraborty et al., 2023；Endres et al., 2024；Lahiri, 2024；Ma et al., 2024；Granberry et al., 2024；Mugnier et al., 2024；Misu et al., 2024；Pirzada et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025；Ma et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: For instance, ( Giacobbe et al., 2022 ; Abate et al., 2021 ) train neural networks as candidate ranking functions, which are subsequently verified via SMT solving to ensure soundness. These techniques heavily rely on the quality and quantity of execution traces for training neural networks. ( Giacobbe et al., 2025 ) trains neural networks to simultaneously represent ranking functions and inductive invariants. Unlike earlier approaches, they do not require execution traces. Instead, the neural networks are trained through a sequence of MILP solving in a counterexample-guided inductive synthesis loop and are designed for hardware verification rather than proving termination of software programs. Note that the decision variant of MILP is NP-complete.

paragraphs.en: PROTON 2.1 ( Mukhopadhyay et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes the Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct model to generate candidate ranking functions. Its effectiveness, however, is limited by the relatively small model size (1B-parameter), the small-scale fine-tuning dataset (321 programs) and the restricted reasoning context. LOOPY ( Kamath et al., 2024 ) , in contrast, prompts LLMs to generate loop invariants and candidate ranking functions directly from natural-language definitions, and then identifies valid candidates using Frama-C ( Baudin et al., 2021 ) . As an early attempt, LOOPY primarily focuses on loop invariant generation and only utilizes the feedback produced by Frama-C to repair incorrect invariants. When a candidate ranking function is incorrect, LOOPY initiates a new interaction with the LLM without incorporating the verification feedback. Although LOOPY has demonstrated the potential of LLMs for ranking function generation, its effectiveness remains limited. Even after embedding expert knowledge (i.e., natural language description of lexicographic and multi-phase ranking functions) into prompts, LOOPY only solves 181 out of 281 benchmarks, much fewer than the state-of-the-art symbolic baseline UAutomizer ( Heizmann et al., 2018 ) , which solves 236 benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: PROTON 2.1（Mukhopadhyay et al., 2025）对 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 模型进行微调，以生成候选排序函数。 然而，其有效性受限于相对较小的模型规模（1B 参数）、小规模的微调数据集（321 个程序）以及受限的推理上下文。 相比之下，LOOPY（Kamath et al., 2024）通过提示大语言模型直接从自然语言定义生成循环不变式和候选排序函数，然后使用 Frama-C（Baudin et al., 2021）识别有效的候选。 作为一次早期尝试，LOOPY 主要专注于循环不变式生成，并且仅利用 Frama-C 产生的反馈来修复不正确的不变式。 当候选排序函数不正确时，LOOPY 会与大语言模型发起新的交互，而不纳入验证反馈。 尽管 LOOPY 已经展示了大语言模型在排序函数生成方面的潜力，但其有效性仍然有限。 即使将专家知识（即字典序和多阶段排序函数的自然语言描述）嵌入提示中，LOOPY 也仅解决了 281 个基准中的 181 个，远少于最先进的符号执行基线 UAutomizer（Heizmann et al., 2018），后者解决了 236 个基准。

sents.zh: 相比之下，LOOPY（Kamath et al., 2024）通过提示大语言模型直接从自然语言定义生成循环不变式和候选排序函数，然后使用 Frama-C（Baudin et al., 2021）识别有效的候选。

sents.en: As an early attempt, LOOPY primarily focuses on loop invariant generation and only utilizes the feedback produced by Frama-C to repair incorrect invariants.
sents.zh: 作为一次早期尝试，LOOPY 主要专注于循环不变式生成，并且仅利用 Frama-C 产生的反馈来修复不正确的不变式。

sents.en: When a candidate ranking function is incorrect, LOOPY initiates a new interaction with the LLM without incorporating the verification feedback.
sents.zh: 当候选排序函数不正确时，LOOPY 会与大语言模型发起新的交互，而不纳入验证反馈。

sents.en: Although LOOPY has demonstrated the potential of LLMs for ranking function generation, its effectiveness remains limited.
sents.zh: 尽管 LOOPY 已经展示了大语言模型在排序函数生成方面的潜力，但其有效性仍然有限。

sents.en: Even after embedding expert knowledge (i.e., natural language description of lexicographic and multi-phase ranking functions) into prompts, LOOPY only solves 181 out of 281 benchmarks, much fewer than the state-of-the-art symbolic baseline UAutomizer ( Heizmann et al., 2018 ) , which solves 236 benchmarks.
sents.zh: 即使将专家知识（即字典序和多阶段排序函数的自然语言描述）嵌入提示中，LOOPY 也仅解决了 281 个基准中的 181 个，远少于最先进的符号执行基线 UAutomizer（Heizmann et al., 2018），后者解决了 236 个基准。

paragraphs.en: There are two major challenges in effectively leveraging LLM for ranking function generation.
paragraphs.zh: 有效利用大语言模型（LLM）生成排序函数存在两大主要挑战。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 1: limited LLM capability. LLMs generate outputs based on statistical patterns learned from training data. As training data usually consists of large-scale natural language text and code corpora, LLMs typically perform well on tasks such as natural language processing and code generation. In contrast, ranking functions are relatively underexplored and is not supported by large or representative training datasets. Consequently, LLMs may have limited capability in reasoning about ranking functions and often struggle with complicated or subtle definitions expressed in natural language. Indeed, out-of-the-box Llama-1B failed to synthesize valid ranking functions even for trivial programs ( Mukhopadhyay et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Challenge 2: identifying and resolving incorrect outputs. Despite the promising performance of LLMs for code generation, they frequently generate incorrect code, often due to limited reasoning context. A particular serious issue is hallucinations ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) where LLMs generate outputs that appear plausible but fail to satisfy the intended specification ( Hagendorff, 2024 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) . For instance, GPT-4 has been shown to generate incomplete assertions as post-conditions so that buggy programs do not violate them ( Endres et al., 2024 ) . We indeed observe similar behavior in our experiments, highlighting the development of techniques that can effectively identify and correct such subtle errors with minimal interaction overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战2：识别并纠正错误输出。 尽管大语言模型在代码生成方面表现出色，但它们经常生成错误的代码，这往往是由于推理上下文有限所致。 一个尤为严重的问题是幻觉（Zhang et al., 2025），即大语言模型生成的输出看似合理，却无法满足预期的规格说明（Hagendorff, 2024；Cao et al., 2025）。 例如，已有研究表明GPT-4会生成不完整的断言作为后置条件，使得有缺陷的程序不会违反这些断言（Endres et al., 2024）。 我们在实验中确实观察到了类似的行为，这凸显了开发能够在最小交互开销下有效识别并纠正此类细微错误的技术的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Our work. To tackle these challenges, we propose a neuro-symbolic framework, RAINFALL ( RA nk IN g F unction gener A tion with LL m), within the generate-verify-refine paradigm, which combines the generative capabilities of modern LLMs with the rigor of symbolic techniques. This integration enables RAINFALL to discover richer termination arguments and prove termination for a broader class of loop programs. We remark that LLM fine-tuning could also be adopted, as demonstrated by PROTON 2.1. We avoid fine-tuning because it is not only cost- and resource-intensive, but also requires large-scale, high-quality training datasets, which otherwise risks overfitting.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, to address the first challenge, RAINFALL first transforms the synthesis of ranking functions into a code-assertion generation problem, motivated by the observation that LLMs are very effective in code and specification generation. This transformation avoids requiring LLMs to interpret complicated definitions of ranking functions and improves the quality of the generated candidate ranking functions. Second, we embed expert knowledge about termination arguments (e.g., lexicographic and multi-phase ranking functions) with few-shot examples into structured prompts which can enhance the reasoning ability and in-context learning of LLMs for code-assertion generation.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，为解决第一个挑战，RAINFALL 首先将排序函数的综合转化为代码断言生成问题，这一做法的动机在于观察到 LLM 在代码与规约生成方面非常有效。 这种转化避免了要求 LLM 解释排序函数的复杂定义，并提升了所生成的候选排序函数的质量。 其次，我们通过少样本示例将关于终止性论证的专家知识（例如字典序与多阶段排序函数）嵌入到结构化提示中，这可以增强 LLM 在代码断言生成方面的推理能力和上下文学习能力。

paragraphs.en: To address the second challenge, we present a symbolic verification pipeline which checks whether the LLM outputs satisfy the required correctness criteria, thereby providing soundness guarantees. In this pipeline, we first ensure that the LLM does not modify the original program by applying a lightweight, syntactic equivalence check. This step prevents potential cheating where the LLM modifies the program and generates assertions that hold only in the modified version. After this, we check the completeness of the generated code-assertion statements required to induce a ranking function (e.g., whether assertions include strict decrease, non-negativity and termination conditions). Without these conditions, valid ranking functions cannot be extracted even if the program satisfies the assertions (e.g., an LLM outputs true as the assertion, which would not be useful). Finally, we verify whether the program satisfies the assertions via safety checking. To repair incorrect outputs with minimal interactions, we re-prompt LLMs by incorporating fine-grained diagnostic information (e.g., the detected program modification, missing ranking function conditions, or counterexample produced by the safety verifier). The corresponding ranking functions can then be extracted and used as a witness to program termination. Remark that we do not copy the LLM-generated code-assertions into the original program and then verify them using the later checks because such code-assertions typically cannot induce a valid ranking function and subsequent checks would incur substantial computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对第二个挑战，我们提出了一个符号验证流水线，用于检查大语言模型的输出是否满足所需的正确性标准，从而提供可靠性保证。 在该流水线中，我们首先通过应用一种轻量级的语法等价性检查，确保大语言模型不会修改原始程序。 这一步骤可防止潜在的作弊行为，即大语言模型修改程序并生成仅在修改后的版本中才成立的断言。 在此之后，我们检查所生成代码-断言语句的完备性，这些语句是推导排序函数所必需的（例如，断言是否包含严格递减、非负性和终止条件）。 缺少这些条件时，即使程序满足断言，也无法提取出有效的排序函数（例如，大语言模型输出 true 作为断言，这将毫无用处）。 最后，我们通过安全性检查来验证程序是否满足这些断言。 为了以最少的交互修复错误的输出，我们通过融入细粒度的诊断信息（例如，检测到的程序修改、缺失的排序函数条件，或安全性验证器产生的反例）来重新提示大语言模型。 随后即可提取相应的排序函数，并将其作为程序终止的见证。 需要说明的是，我们并不将大语言模型生成的代码-断言复制到原始程序中再用后续检查进行验证，因为此类代码-断言通常无法推导出有效的排序函数，且后续检查会带来巨大的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RAINFALL on two public benchmark suites comprising 358 terminating C programs. Using MiniMax (V2.7) ( Min, 2026 ) , RAINFALL generates verifiable ranking functions for 323 programs (90.22%), outperforming six state-of-the-art tools such as AProVE ( Lommen and Giesl, 2025 ) (78.77%), UAutomizer (79.05%), LOOPY (73.74%) and PROTON 2.1 (86.87%). Ablation studies confirm that formulating ranking-function synthesis as a code-assertion generation task, together with few-shot examples and diagnostic information feedback is critical to this performance. We further show that RAINFALL remains effective across LLMs (e.g., proved more programs in less time using GPT V5.5 ( GPT, 2026 ) and Claude-Opus V4.7 ( Cla, 2026 ) ) and complements other tools (e.g., a 96.65% success rate, solving 346 tasks when combined with the symbolic counterpart of PROTON 2.1).

paragraphs.en: This paper focuses on synthesizing ranking functions for proving termination of loop programs using three common classes of ranking functions. More broadly, however, our promising results point toward a generic, sound framework for ranking-function synthesis and, beyond termination, LLM-assisted synthesis of formally checkable liveness certificates, both of which represent frontiers of software engineering research.

paragraphs.en: First, the framework naturally accommodates new classes of ranking functions. The strong empirical performance of RAINFALL , together with its complementarity with existing symbolic termination tools, suggests that LLM-assisted certificate synthesis could extend beyond termination to the verification of progress, fairness, response, and other temporal properties of software systems.

paragraphs.en: A standard approach for proving termination of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is to synthesize a ranking function that maps program states to elements of a well-founded set such that the value strictly decreases along every transition. paragraphs.en: Single ranking function synthesis. The most standard approach to proving program termination is via ranking functions that decrease along every loop iteration. Podelski and Rybalchenko ( Podelski and Rybalchenko, 2004 ) gave a complete method for synthesizing linear ranking functions on linear loops. Later work relaxes the strict decrease requirement, e.g., by eventual linear ranking functions ( Bagnara and Mesnard, 2013 ) . These approaches typically reduce the synthesis problem to constraint solving (via, e.g., Farkas’ lemma), but are limited in expressiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 单一排序函数合成。 证明程序终止的最标准方法是通过在每次循环迭代中递减的排序函数。 Podelski 和 Rybalchenko（Podelski 和 Rybalchenko，2004）给出了一种在线性循环上合成线性排序函数的完备方法。 后续工作放宽了严格递减的要求，例如最终线性排序函数（Bagnara 和 Mesnard，2013）。 这些方法通常将合成问题归约为约束求解（例如通过 Farkas 引理），但表达能力有限。

paragraphs.en: Template-based ranking function synthesis. Template-based approaches synthesize ranking functions by reducing the problem to constraint solving over predefined templates. For a chosen ranking function class, a parameterized template with unknown coefficients is fixed, and synthesis amounts to finding coefficient values that satisfy the required conditions. Common templates include linear ( Leike and Heizmann, 2015 ) , multiphase ( Ben-Amram and Genaim, 2017 ) , and lexicographic ranking functions ( Bradley et al., 2005a ; Bradley et al., 2005b ; Alias et al., 2010 ; Ben-Amram and Genaim, 2014 ) , as introduced in Section 2 . For example, to synthesize a single linear ranking function for a loop with guard ϕ \phi , one can use an affine template f ⁡ ( x → ) = a → ⋅ x → + c f(\vec{x})=\vec{a}\cdot\vec{x}+c , where a → \vec{a} and c c are unknown. The synthesis task reduces to determining a → \vec{a} and c c such that the ranking function conditions hold for all program transitions and f ⁡ ( x → ) ​ ¡ ​ 0 ⟹ ¬ ϕ f(\vec{x})<0\implies\neg\phi . Leike and Heizmann ( Leike and Heizmann, 2015 ) reduce the synthesis problem of common ranking functions above to solving nonlinear constraints via SMT. More expressive templates may use polynomial or rational expressions, or multiple components as in multiphase and lexicographic ranking functions. Thus, the effectiveness of template-based methods depends heavily on choosing suitable templates, a task that aligns well with the strengths of LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模板的排序函数合成。 基于模板的方法通过将问题归约为在预定义模板上的约束求解来合成排序函数。 对于选定的排序函数类别，先固定一个带有未知系数的参数化模板，合成任务即为找到满足所需条件的系数取值。 常见的模板包括线性排序函数（Leike and Heizmann, 2015）、多阶段排序函数（Ben-Amram and Genaim, 2017）以及字典序排序函数（Bradley et al., 2005a; Bradley et al., 2005b; Alias et al., 2010; Ben-Amram and Genaim, 2014），如第 2 节所述。 例如，要为具有守护条件 ϕ \phi 的循环合成单个线性排序函数，可以使用仿射模板 f ⁡ ( x → ) = a → ⋅ x → + c f(\vec{x})=\vec{a}\cdot\vec{x}+c，其中 a → \vec{a} 和 c c 是未知的。 合成任务于是归约为确定 a → \vec{a} 和 c c，使得排序函数条件对所有程序转移成立，并且 f ⁡ ( x → ) ​ ¡ ​ 0 ⟹ ¬ ϕ f(\vec{x})<0\implies\neg\phi。 Leike 和 Heizmann（Leike and Heizmann, 2015）将上述常见排序函数的合成问题归约为通过 SMT 求解非线性约束。 更具表达力的模板可以使用多项式或有理表达式，或像多阶段排序函数和字典序排序函数那样使用多个分量。 因此，基于模板的方法的有效性在很大程度上取决于选择合适的模板，而这一任务与 LLM 的优势高度契合。

paragraphs.en: Data-driven techniques. Some learning-based approaches predict termination without formal guarantees ( Alon and David, 2022 ) , while others adopt a learn-and-check paradigm ( Nori and Sharma, 2013 ; Urban et al., 2016 ; Xu et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2022 ) . Neural approaches, in particular, learn candidate functions from execution traces and validate them using SMT ( Giacobbe et al., 2022 ; Abate et al., 2021 ) . However, these methods rely heavily on the availability of high-quality execution data.
paragraphs.zh: 数据驱动技术。 一些基于学习的方法在没有形式化保证的情况下预测终止性（Alon and David, 2022），而另一些方法则采用“学习-验证”范式（Nori and Sharma, 2013；Urban et al., 2016；Xu et al., 2022；Li et al., 2022）。 神经网络方法尤其如此，它们从执行轨迹中学习候选函数，并使用SMT进行验证（Giacobbe et al., 2022；Abate et al., 2021）。 然而，这些方法严重依赖高质量执行数据的可获得性。

paragraphs.en: Other symbolic approaches. Alternative approaches reason about transition relations and exploit transition invariants. Key techniques include size-change analysis ( Lee et al., 2001 ) , refinement ( Chawdhary et al., 2008 ; Cook et al., 2006 ) , variance analysis ( Berdine et al., 2007 ; Podelski and Rybalchenko, 2005 ; Kroening et al., 2010 ) , abstract interpretation ( Cousot and Cousot, 2012 ) , temporal reasoning ( Le et al., 2014 ; Le et al., 2015 ) , and interprocedural summarization ( Chen et al., 2018a ) . Some techniques further address complex data structures, e.g., heaps ( Berdine et al., 2006 ) , pointers ( Cook et al., 2006 ) , and lists ( Hensel and Giesl, 2023 ) .

paragraphs.en: Termination checking tools. AProVE ( Lommen and Giesl, 2025 ) uses integer transition systems (ITS) and integrates KoAT ( Lommen and Giesl, 2026 ) for inferring complexity bounds of ITS. Both UAutomizer ( Heizmann et al., 2014 ; Chen et al., 2018b ) and T2 (and its predecessor Terminator ) ( Cook et al., 2006 ; Cook et al., 2013 ; Brockschmidt et al., 2016 ) iteratively prove termination by analyzing cycles; UAutomizer employs automata-based reasoning to discover new cycles, while T2 reduces the problem to safety checking. FreqTerm ( Fedyukovich et al., 2018 ) enumerates candidate ranking functions, whereas ddlTerm ( Xu et al., 2022 ) adopts a data-driven approach to learn loop bounds. PROTON 2.1 ( Mukhopadhyay et al., 2025 ) leverages fine-tuned LLMs to handle cases not solved by PROTON 1.1.2 ( Metta et al., 2024 ) , a bounded model checking-based tool. Other tools include DynamiTe ( Le et al., 2020 ) and FuncTion ( Urban, 2015 ) . Related work also addresses non-termination ( Gupta et al., 2008 ; Chen et al., 2014 ; Han and He, 2023 ) and LLM-based prediction ( Sultan et al., 2026 ) , which is not our focus.
paragraphs.zh: 终止性检查工具。 AProVE（Lommen and Giesl, 2025）使用整数迁移系统（ITS），并集成了 KoAT（Lommen and Giesl, 2026）来推断 ITS 的复杂度上界。 UAutomizer（Heizmann et al., 2014; Chen et al., 2018b）和 T2（及其前身 Terminator）（Cook et al., 2006; Cook et al., 2013; Brockschmidt et al., 2016）都通过分析循环来迭代地证明终止性；UAutomizer 采用基于自动机的推理来发现新的循环，而 T2 则将该问题归约为安全性检查。 FreqTerm（Fedyukovich et al., 2018）枚举候选排序函数，而 ddlTerm（Xu et al., 2022）采用数据驱动的方法来学习循环上界。 PROTON 2.1（Mukhopadhyay et al., 2025）利用微调后的大语言模型来处理 PROTON 1.1.2（Metta et al., 2024）（一个基于有界模型检查的工具）未能解决的情形。 其他工具还包括 DynamiTe（Le et al., 2020）和 FuncTion（Urban, 2015）。 相关工作还涉及非终止性（Gupta et al., 2008; Chen et al., 2014; Han and He, 2023）以及基于大语言模型的预测（Sultan et al., 2026），但这些并非我们的关注点。

Given a C program 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and resource constraints (e.g., budgets on LLM queries and execution time), RAINFALL aims to synthesize a ranking function f f within these limits to prove the termination by generating a verified program 𝒫 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚟𝚎𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt proved} . paragraphs.en: RAINFALL consists of two main phases: preprocessing and iterative generation-verification . In the preprocessing phase (cf. Section 4.1 ), RAINFALL performs program instrumentation and prompt construction . It first automatically instruments 𝒫 \mathcal{P} by inserting four predefined code and assertion placeholders at selected locations for each loop, resulting in an instrumented program 𝒫 𝚒𝚗𝚜𝚝𝚛 \mathcal{P}_{\tt instr} . This reduces ranking function synthesis to a code-assertion generation problem on 𝒫 𝚒𝚗𝚜𝚝𝚛 \mathcal{P}_{\tt instr} . Next, it constructs a structured prompt ℳ 𝚒𝚗𝚒𝚝 \mathcal{M}_{\tt init} based on 𝒫 𝚒𝚗𝚜𝚝𝚛 \mathcal{P}_{\tt instr} , natural language descriptions and few-shot examples of ranking functions, and queries the LLM accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: RAINFALL 包含两个主要阶段：预处理和迭代式生成-验证。 在预处理阶段（参见 第 4.1 节），RAINFALL 执行程序插桩和提示词构建。 它首先通过在每个循环的选定位置插入四个预定义的代码和断言占位符，对 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 进行自动插桩，得到插桩后的程序 𝒫 𝚒𝚗𝚜𝚝𝚛 \mathcal{P}_{\tt instr}。 这将排序函数的合成问题归约为在 𝒫 𝚒𝚗𝚜𝚝𝚛 \mathcal{P}_{\tt instr} 上的代码-断言生成问题。 接着，它基于 𝒫 𝚒𝚗𝚜𝚝𝚛 \mathcal{P}_{\tt instr}、排序函数的自然语言描述以及少样本示例，构建结构化提示词 ℳ 𝚒𝚗𝚒𝚝 \mathcal{M}_{\tt init}，并据此向大语言模型发起查询。

paragraphs.en: The symbolic verification pipeline comprises three components: syntactic equivalence checking , which ensures that the original code in 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is not modified by the LLM; code-assertion completeness checking , which verifies that the generated assertions cover strict decrease, non-negativity, and termination conditions; and assertion checking , which validates the correctness of these assertions. Otherwise, diagnostic information is incorporated into the ℳ 𝚒𝚗𝚒𝚝 \mathcal{M}_{\tt init} , leading to the prompt ℳ 𝚏𝚋 \mathcal{M}_{\tt fb} for the subsequent iteration (a new interaction with the LLM using ℳ 𝚏𝚋 \mathcal{M}_{\tt fb} ), to refine the LLM output. This process repeats until a valid ranking function is found, or the resource budget is exhausted.

paragraphs.en: To detect such incorrect outputs, we adopt a lightweight syntactic equivalence checking to ensure that the original code in 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is not modified by the LLM. We build ASTs for both the original program 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and the LLM-generated program 𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand} (after removing the code-assertions inserted by the LLM), and compare them for equivalence. 𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand} proceeds to the next checking if it passes this equivalence checking; otherwise, diagnostic information is fed back to refine the LLM output.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检测这类错误输出，我们采用一种轻量级的语法等价性检查，以确保 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 中的原始代码未被大语言模型修改。 我们为原始程序 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 和大语言模型生成的程序 𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand}（在移除大语言模型插入的代码断言之后）分别构建抽象语法树，并对它们进行等价性比较。𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand} 若通过该等价性检查，则进入下一项检查；否则，诊断信息会被反馈用于修正大语言模型的输出。

sents.en: This procedure is sound because (1) the equivalence checking ensures that the original code of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is not modified in 𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand} , and (2) the completeness checking ensures that all the required code-assertions have been properly instantiated in 𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand} .

sents.en: Consequently, if the assertions are valid in 𝒫 𝚌𝚊𝚗𝚍 \mathcal{P}_{\tt cand} , they collectively induce a valid ranking function for proving termination of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} .

paragraphs.en: Benchmark. We consider two public benchmark suites provided by LOOPY and FreqTerm , denoted by BS-L and BS-F, respectively. BS-L consists of 188 terminating C programs (after deduplicating 93 programs with identical ASTs but different lines of code), while BS-F contains 170 terminating C programs, after removing a non-terminating instance. These benchmarks were originally collected from the termination category of SV-COMP, covering a range of typical loop patterns, including linear, non-linear and conditional branches. (Note that one of them uses a for-loop, which is transformed into an equivalent while-loop.) We do not evaluate on the entire SV-COMP Termination benchmarks mainly because of the high token cost of LLM-based experiments. Nevertheless, the selected benchmarks are sufficiently large and diverse for a meaningful evaluation. In particular, ddlterm ( Xu et al., 2022 ) (ICSE 2022) evaluates exclusively on the BS-F benchmark suite; similarly, CondTerm ( Huang et al., 2026 ) (ICSE 2026) uses only the 170 terminating programs from BS-F.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们考虑由 LOOPY 和 FreqTerm 提供的两个公开基准套件，分别记为 BS-L 和 BS-F。 BS-L 由 188 个会终止的 C 程序组成（在去重了 93 个抽象语法树相同但代码行数不同的程序之后），而 BS-F 在移除一个不终止的实例后包含 170 个会终止的 C 程序。 这些基准最初收集自 SV-COMP 的终止类测试，涵盖多种典型的循环模式，包括线性、非线性以及条件分支。 （注意，其中一个程序使用 for 循环，我们将其转换为等价的 while 循环。）我们之所以没有在完整的 SV-COMP Termination 基准上进行评估，主要是因为基于大语言模型的实验 token 开销过高。 尽管如此，所选基准的规模和多样性已足以支持有意义的评估。 特别地，ddlterm（Xu 等人，2022）（ICSE 2022）仅在 BS-F 基准套件上进行评估；类似地，CondTerm（Huang 等人，2026）（ICSE 2026）也只使用 BS-F 中的 170 个会终止的程序。

paragraphs.en: Overall, RAINFALL outperforms all baselines, solving the largest number of tasks across both benchmark suites. In particular, RAINFALL solves 12 more tasks than PROTON , the best-performing baseline and winner of the SV-COMP 2026 Termination Category. PRO-LLM solves only 11 tasks on BS-F and 4 on BS-L, all of which are already solvable by PROTON without invoking its fine-tuned LLM. Compared to the LLM-based tool LOOPY , which uses the same LLM (i.e., MiniMax) to generate ranking functions instead of code-assertions, RAINFALL solves 59 additional tasks. In terms of efficiency, RAINFALL not only solves more tasks but also requires fewer LLM queries than LOOPY .

paragraphs.en: Without few-shot examples, syntactic equivalence, code-assertion completeness and assertion checkings report 5, 38 and 17 errors, respectively. Under the full setting of 2 solving attempts × \times 6 LLM queries/attempt with few-shot examples, the three checks report 10, 9 and 15 errors in total, respectively. These results highlight that the symbolic verification pipeline is a critical component of RAINFALL .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RAINFALL on two public benchmark suites, and its effectiveness may differ on other benchmarks or real-world programs. Because modern LLMs are typically trained on large corpora containing publicly available code, these benchmarks may have been included in their training data, raising the possibility of benchmark contamination. We mitigate this concern by synthesizing code assertions rather than directly generating ranking functions. To the best of our knowledge, no public benchmark contains the code assertions used by our framework. Evaluating RAINFALL on additional benchmark suites and real-world programs remains an important direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: We presented RAINFALL , a novel neuro-symbolic framework for ranking function synthesis. Our approaches formulates ranking function synthesis as a code-assertion generation problem using dedicated placeholders, enabling seamless integration of modern LLMs within an iterative generate-verify-refine workflow. We showed that incorporating expert knowledge of ranking functions, few-shot examples and diagnostic information into prompts can significantly enhance generation accuracy. To ensure soundness, we developed a symbolic verification pipeline tailored to our LLM-generated code-assertion. Experimental results show that RAINFALL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and complements existing symbolic termination analysis tools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RAINFALL，一个用于排序函数合成的创新神经符号框架。 我们的方法将排序函数合成表述为使用专用占位符的代码-断言生成问题，使现代大语言模型能够无缝集成到迭代式的生成-验证-精炼工作流中。 我们证明了将排序函数的专家知识、少样本示例和诊断信息融入提示中，可以显著提升生成准确率。 为确保可靠性，我们开发了一个针对大语言模型生成的代码-断言量身定制的符号验证流水线。 实验结果表明，RAINFALL 优于最先进的基线方法，并与现有的符号终止性分析工具形成互补。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, this work demonstrates the promise of combining the generative capabilities of LLMs with the formal rigor of symbolic verification for ranking-function synthesis. As LLMs continue to improve, we expect this neuro-symbolic paradigm to become an increasingly effective approach to automated termination proving.
